create.name: Mahasukha
create.bio:
Mahasukha is a Buddhist singing and mantra teacher, musician and voice coach based in Brighton. He started on drums at eleven, played in bands for years, took an advanced diploma in music and has now been a working musician for close to fifty years. His Buddhist name means great bliss, and the idea of making a sacred, spacious setting runs through all his work. For over twenty years he has led group singing and mantra events with thousands of people, and he has recorded several albums of chants and songs.

Soulful Singing is his regular Saturday workshop in Brighton, also taken to Bristol and elsewhere in the UK: simple songs, chants and mantras from many cultures, learned by ear and sung in harmony, with no experience needed. Beauty of Mantra is more ceremonial, with Buddhist mantras sung in parts to his drumming in front of a shrine, with candle offerings, as a way of calling on the qualities of particular Buddhas and bodhisattvas. He also leads retreats, and offers one-to-one mantra lessons, guided meditation sessions focused on breath, body and kind awareness, and Embodied Voice sessions that use breath, movement and singing to build vocal confidence, in Brighton or on Zoom.

courses.title: Soulful Singing workshops
courses.description: Saturday morning group singing in Brighton, and workshops in Bristol and around the UK: easy chants, mantras and songs gathered from many cultures, taught by ear and sung in part harmony. Venues and dates vary.
courses.price: £15 GBP (£13 concession), pay on the door

courses.title: Beauty of Mantra
courses.description: Evening and workshop rituals of Buddhist mantra sung in harmony to hand drumming before a shrine, with candle offerings, each mantra invoking a different Buddha or bodhisattva. Held in Brighton, Bristol and elsewhere in the UK.

courses.title: 1:1 Mantra sessions
courses.description: Private lessons for learning Buddhist mantras and growing confidence in chanting them, drawn from his large repertoire, in Brighton or on Zoom.

courses.title: Guided meditation sessions
courses.description: Individual guided sits that bring attention to the body and breath and to whatever arises, met with curiosity and kindness. Available on Zoom and in Brighton.

courses.title: The Embodied Voice
courses.description: One-to-one voice sessions using breathing, movement and singing exercises to free the voice and build confidence, sometimes with a song or mantra to learn. In Brighton (plus studio hire) or on Zoom.

free_resources.title: Mahasukha on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Mantras and guided practices from Mahasukha, free to listen to in the app or online.
